name: Ace of Swords
title: Ace of Swords
imagery: A hand reaches from a cloud holding a sword point upward. The blade pierces a crown, and branches hang from the crown on either side. Small flames or drops fall around it.
meaning: The Ace of Swords cuts through confusion. Truth, clarity and a decisive breakthrough are offered. Use your mind and words with precision and courage.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of Air, the full power of thought in one blade.
affirmation: I see clearly and speak the truth.

ctx.past: A moment of clarity changed your thinking.
ctx.present: Truth is cutting through confusion now.
ctx.future: A breakthrough or decisive insight is coming.
ctx.challenge: Harsh words or cold logic can wound.
ctx.advice: Decide clearly. Speak your truth with care.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a truth you avoid.

name: Two of Swords
title: Two of Swords
imagery: Two curved swords bend into an oval that encloses a flower at its center. Their curves cross at top and bottom like a protective frame.
meaning: The Two of Swords is a stalemate or careful balance. A decision is pending. The flower inside the blades suggests something tender being protected.
affirmation: I find balance and make clear choices.

ctx.present: You are at a standstill. Weigh carefully.
ctx.future: A decision between two options is coming.
ctx.advice: Look at both sides, then decide.
ctx.love: A love at a standstill or protected heart.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask for inner balance.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be avoided feelings.
ctx.foundation: A balance of forces underlies this.

name: Three of Swords
title: Three of Swords
imagery: Two curved swords form an oval while a third, straight sword stands upright through the middle, cutting through the enclosed flowers.
meaning: The Three of Swords brings a painful clarity. A truth or decision cuts through what was protected. It hurts, but it brings release and understanding.
numerology: Three is creation; here it creates through cutting away.

ctx.future: A difficult but clarifying moment is coming.
ctx.advice: Accept the truth and let healing begin.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be old wounds.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to face pain.

name: Four of Swords
title: Four of Swords
imagery: Four curved swords form an oval around a central flower, all balanced and still. There is no straight sword cutting through.
meaning: The Four of Swords calls for rest. After conflict, retreat and recover. Peace returns through stillness.
affirmation: I rest and recover my strength.

ctx.past: A period of rest helped you heal.
ctx.future: A time of recovery is coming.
ctx.work: Take a break to avoid burnout.
ctx.gift: Your gift is knowing when to pause.

name: Five of Swords
title: Five of Swords
imagery: Four curved swords form an oval while a fifth straight sword stands in the center, slicing through the enclosed space.
meaning: The Five of Swords brings conflict and tension. Words may wound. Consider whether winning is worth the cost.
numerology: Five breaks stability and brings conflict.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be hurt pride.
ctx.gift: Your gift is knowing when to walk away.

name: Six of Swords
title: Six of Swords
imagery: Six curved swords form a balanced oval pattern with a flower at the center. The design is harmonious and calm.
meaning: The Six of Swords brings mental calm and transition. You are moving toward smoother waters.

ctx.past: You left a difficult situation behind.
ctx.advice: Move on and let calm return.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be lingering sadness.

name: Seven of Swords
title: Seven of Swords
imagery: Six curved swords form an oval while a straight seventh sword runs through the center.
meaning: The Seven of Swords calls for strategy and cleverness. Think carefully, and watch for deception.
affirmation: I act with wisdom and integrity.

ctx.past: A clever move in the past.
ctx.future: You may need to be cunning.

name: Eight of Swords
title: Eight of Swords
imagery: Eight curved swords interlock in a dense pattern around a central flower, tightly enclosing it.
meaning: The Eight of Swords shows mental restriction. You may feel trapped by your thoughts. Freedom begins with a new perspective.

ctx.future: A period of restriction may come.

name: Nine of Swords
title: Nine of Swords
imagery: Eight curved swords form an oval with a ninth straight sword running through the center.
meaning: The Nine of Swords reflects worry and anxiety. Much of the fear lives in the mind. Seek support and perspective.

ctx.future: A time of concern may come.

name: Ten of Swords
title: Ten of Swords
imagery: Ten curved swords crowd the card in a dense, interwoven oval. As an even number, it has no straight sword cutting through the middle; the pattern is full and closed.
meaning: The Ten of Swords marks a painful ending. It is over, and from here things can only improve.
affirmation: I accept endings and rise again.

ctx.advice: Accept the ending and move on.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to start over.

name: Page of Swords
title: Valet of Swords
imagery: A young valet stands holding a sword, often with its sheath in his other hand. He seems alert and ready.
meaning: The Valet of Swords is curious and alert. He seeks truth and brings news. Stay vigilant and keep learning.
numerology: The Valet is the student of the suit.

ctx.others: A sharp young person is involved.

name: Knight of Swords
title: Knight of Swords
imagery: A knight rides with his sword raised, horse in motion. He charges forward with purpose.
meaning: The Knight of Swords acts fast and fearlessly. He pursues his goals with conviction, sometimes too quickly.
numerology: The Knight carries the suit into action.
affirmation: I act with clarity and courage.

name: Queen of Swords
title: Queen of Swords
imagery: A queen sits holding a sword upright, her expression clear and composed. She sees through pretense.
meaning: The Queen of Swords is honest, perceptive and independent. She speaks truth with clarity.
numerology: The Queen holds the suit inwardly.
affirmation: I speak my truth with clarity.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be old hurt.

name: King of Swords
title: King of Swords
imagery: A king sits holding a sword, his posture firm and commanding. He rules with reason.
meaning: The King of Swords rules with intellect and fairness. He makes clear decisions based on truth.
numerology: The King holds the suit outwardly with mastery.
affirmation: I lead with wisdom and fairness.

ctx.future: Authority or a fair decision is coming.
ctx.others: A logical authority figure is involved.
